> Set up each remote host's own integrations from the hub, find and clear sites stuck in maintenance mode, and several web UI fixes for dialogs, page transitions and shared installs.

### Upgrade Steps

* [ACTION REQUIRED] Install on 3.6.x: run `sudo cwcli self-update` on a shared install or `cwcli self-update` on a per-user install; it upgrades cwcli and restarts the services that were running.
* [ACTION REQUIRED] Per-user install still on 3.5.x or older: its `cwcli self-update` upgrades cwcli but does not restart anything, so after it finishes, restart each cwcli service you had running so that it runs 3.7.0:
  * Web UI: `cwcli ui --stop`, then `cwcli ui`.
  * Auto-inspect: `cwcli config auto-inspect stop`, then `cwcli config auto-inspect enable`.
  * Credential bridge: `cwcli config cred-bridge stop`, then `cwcli config cred-bridge start`.
* [ACTION REQUIRED] Shared install still on 3.5.x or older: its own `sudo cwcli self-update` cannot upgrade the shared install, so upgrade it this one time by hand:
  * Find the folders: `readlink -f "$(command -v cwcli)"` prints `<tool dir>/caffeinated-whale-cli/bin/cwcli`, and the folder that holds `command -v cwcli` is `<bin dir>`. `<owner>` is the account that owns `<tool dir>` (`stat -c %U <tool dir>`).
  * Run `sudo -u <owner> env PATH="$PATH" UV_TOOL_DIR=<tool dir> UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR=<bin dir> uv tool upgrade caffeinated-whale-cli`.
  * If the shared scheduler is installed, run `sudo cwcli schedule daemon --install-service`, then `sudo systemctl restart cwcli-scheduler.service`.
  * If the machine-wide credential bridge is installed, run `sudo systemctl restart cwcli-cred-bridge.service`.
  * Each member who has a web UI running runs `cwcli ui --stop`, then `cwcli ui`.
* [ACTION REQUIRED] Verify: run `cwcli --version` and check that it prints `3.7.0`.

### New Features

* The hub's Settings > Integrations has a machine picker: pick a remote host to set up its own Cloudflare DNS and Nginx Proxy Manager from the hub. Test, Detect and Save run on that host and its secrets stay there; when the host granted the hub less than the Admin cap, the panel names the `cwcli remote allow ... --max-role admin` command to run on it. Publishing a site on a remote instance uses that host's settings and says so.
* `cwcli status` finds sites stuck in maintenance mode, including the bench-wide flag that makes every site answer 503, and offers to take them out; `--clear-maintenance` does it without asking (`--site` for one site). The web UI shows the fault on the instance, bench, site and Sites pages and offers the same fix.

### Bug Fixes

* Settings and the other web UI dialogs no longer overflow sideways: long keys, commands, paths and addresses stay inside the dialog at every width, including on a phone.
* A click or tap made while the web UI moves between pages now reaches the new page instead of being dropped.
* On a shared install, the Apps page shows app sources to every member using the machine's shared credential, lists a source while its first scan runs with its progress, and marks a forge nobody is signed in to as not signed in.
* GitLab app-source scans no longer fail when the web UI was started from inside a repository.
* The web UI sidebar's last instance is no longer cut off against the footer.
